items.Sentence: Wastewater flows by gravity to two 21,300 gallon septic tanks, one installed for each the eastbound and westbound rest areas.
Currently, wastewater from the septic tanks is pumped either to a stabilization pond or to a leachfield, which are both located on the westbound rest area property.
Effluent from the stabilization pond is chlorine disinfected and discharged to a sprayfield for the remainder of the year.
Wastewater is discharged to the leachfield during the winter months.

By the end of Fall 2018, the Discharger plans to complete construction of a new wastewater treatment system that consists of two lift stations with two grinder pumps each...
Pond 1 serves as an aeration treatment pond and will be lined with a 60-mil high density polyethylene (HDPE) liner.
Treated wastewater will be conveyed by gravity flow to either Pond 2 or 3 for disposal, which will occur via evaporation and percolation.
